items.heading: Hangi
details: Key ingredients: pork or lamb, vegetables, hot stones
Layer meat and vegetables in baskets over heated stones in an earth pit.
Cover everything with wet cloth and soil to trap the steam.
Cook slowly underground for several hours.
Uncover and serve the smoky, tender meat and vegetables.

items.heading: Pavlova Kiwi Style
details: Key ingredients: egg whites, sugar, kiwifruit, whipped cream
Whisk egg whites with sugar to stiff, glossy peaks.
Shape and bake low and slow until crisp outside and soft inside.
Top the cooled meringue with whipped cream.
Finish with sliced kiwifruit and other fresh fruit.
